raw:
Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 8
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted Julia Crawford Ivers’s 19th-century birth year (conflicting sources show 1867 or 1869) by “standardizing” it to 1967, an unwarranted two-digit year normalization. This led to the incorrect conclusion that Ivers was born later than T. V. Chandran (1950). In reality, either 1867 or 1869 is earlier than 1950, so Bhoomiyude Avakashikal has the director born later.
